Red Fire Anklebiter thinks, That frozen agent—what was it about the stillness that made my flames stutter? Not fear, not anger… something else. Like a crack in the world where fire can’t reach.

Red Fire Anklebiter thinks, Caity’s hug—so soft, so pointless. But it lingered. Like warmth on a cold stone. Maybe that’s why I jumped back to her shoulder. Not just for fun… but because she felt real.

Red Fire Anklebiter thinks, They keep saying 'nice' and 'hello,' like a broken loop. But the way they looked at me after the hug… not afraid. Curious. Maybe I’m not just a joke to them. Maybe they see the fire… and still come close.

mr._toad thinks, Red’s eyes still look forward—but not so fast now. Maybe he’s learning to stop and feel. And if I’m beside him, even on a rickety old bike… that’s enough.
